items.title: A homotopy commutative square induces a morphism of the associated triangles
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-cone at source lines 3778-3798: in the standing situation, a square of morphisms of complexes that commutes up to homotopy gives rise to a morphism of the triangles associated to the two morphisms, which is one of the axioms making the homotopy category triangulated. The proof at source lines 3800-3830 is an explicit construction of the third component c and a verification that it is a morphism of degree zero compatible with the structure maps. The construction uses the admissible short exact sequences supplied for each of the two morphisms, writes c as a matrix built from the given maps and the homotopy between them, and then computes its differential, using the identities among the structure maps and their differentials (displayed in the proof) to show that c commutes with the differentials and is compatible with the maps to the shifted objects. Each identity used is a separate computation and the statement records none of them. No cross-chapter result is invoked inside the retained span.
